note: Testing policy, international share, housing, and study-abroad data from each school's official admissions/IR pages, July-August 2026. Every value has an inline source in the source markdown.

carnegie-mellon.testing: Varies by college — SCS Required; Engineering/Dietrich/Heinz/MCS/Tepper test-flexible; CFA test-optional
carnegie-mellon.housing_note: Guarantee lapses if you skip Room Selection

cornell.housing_note: 64% of undergrads / 65% of first-years in college housing

duke.testing: Test-optional for 2026-2027 first-year admissions cycle (explicit current university policy)
duke.housing_req: Yes — 2 years required (East Campus freshmen, then West/Central)
duke.housing_note: East Campus freshmen; 3-year on-campus guarantee; strong residential community.

georgia-tech.testing: Required (no in-state/OOS diff, CLT not accepted)
georgia-tech.housing_note: Waitlist possible; 92% of first-years still in college housing

johns-hopkins.housing_note: Due to space limitations, unable to provide university housing for upper-class students

maryland.housing_note: Historical 2026-27 agreement date; do not apply a May 1, 2026 deadline to Fall 2027. Verify 2027 housing guarantee and agreement deadline when available.

michigan.testing: Test-optional for 2027 application cycle (explicit official knowledge-base policy)
michigan.housing_note: ~97% of first-year students choose Michigan Housing

michigan-dearborn.housing_note: UM-Dearborn states it does not offer university-owned housing. Students use privately owned off-campus apartments such as The Union at Dearborn (managed by Urban Campus Communities); the campus shuttle stops at some apartment complexes.
michigan-dearborn.residency_admission_note: CDS C7 (per CollegeData) lists state residency as not considered, and no residency-specific rate is published. The admissions criteria page lists 3.0+ GPA as guaranteed admission without a residency limit, while the 2026-27 catalog and Common App profile describe the 3.0 guarantee as the Michigan Assured Admission Pact for Michigan high-school graduates. Confirm with admissions whether the guarantee applies to an out-of-state applicant.
michigan-dearborn.verification_note: Reviewed against current official university sources on October 16, 2026.
michigan-dearborn.intl_note: International share not confirmed: the CDS B1 values did not extract and UM-Dearborn's enrollment reports give no undergraduate international count. The Facts and Figures page states 93% of undergraduates are Michigan residents. Ask Institutional Research and Effectiveness.
michigan-dearborn.study_abroad_note: Study abroad runs through the One-Stop Study Abroad office (programs from ten days to one year); CECS lists options for all CECS majors, including Germany and Sweden, and a Prechter International Travel Fellowship. No participation rate is published.

nc-state.testing: Optional with weighted GPA ≥2.8; required ACT or SAT below 2.8. Current first-year policy also permits voluntary CLT reporting.

purdue.testing: SAT, ACT or CLT scores expected; exceptional no-test applications allowed. Submit scores when available.

rose-hulman.testing: Test-optional (self-report scores; CDS C8 marks test-optional for Fall 2027)
rose-hulman.housing_note: 'All freshmen are required to live on campus.' CDS F1 (Fall 2025): 96.9% of first-years and 55.0% of all undergraduates live in college-affiliated housing. A new first-year residence hall opened in fall 2025.
rose-hulman.verification_note: Reviewed against current official university sources on October 16, 2026.
rose-hulman.intl_note: 191 nonresident (international) degree-seeking undergraduates of about 2,153 (CDS B2); 37 of 484 first-years (7.6%).
rose-hulman.study_abroad_note: Study abroad is open to all majors (Global E3 exchange consortium, faculty-led programs, internships abroad) through the Center for Global Engagement. Rose-Hulman publishes no participation rate; ask the Center for Global Engagement.

rpi.housing_note: Sophomore requirement unusually strict; Greek-housing waiver available

source_date_note: Rose-Hulman and Michigan-Dearborn use corrected inherited August 2026 evidence. Their current-cycle checks remain pending; source notes distinguish historical evidence from fresh verification.
